description: Per-tenant agent capabilities. A Super Admin ticks the capabilities a tenant's agents may use in Manage Tenant; the list is stored in tenants.agentCapabilities ("all" = every capability). For that tenant the platform drops heartbeat data of an unticked capability, refuses to hand its agents an instruction that needs one, leaves it out of the configuration agents pull, and the tenant's users see and can toggle only ticked capabilities. "alwaysOn" capabilities cannot be unticked (the platform keeps agents up to date). Read by backend/agent_capabilities.py, components/ManageTenantModal.tsx and components/ManageAgentCapabilitiesModal.tsx.
